metadata.description: Spark Bitcoin L2 wallet proxy for AI agents — scoped HTTP API access to a server-held Spark wallet, with bearer-token auth, role-based permissions, spending limits, L402 paywall payment, and Vercel deployment automation

plugins.name: sparkbtcbot-proxy
plugins.description: Use a Spark Bitcoin L2 wallet proxy for AI agents via HTTP API. Bundles two skills: the API-usage skill (check balances, send payments, create invoices, pay L402 paywalls — all without holding the mnemonic) and the deploy skill (stand up a new proxy on Vercel).
